01.title: Median approved service charge by community, 2026
01.source: DLD Service Charge Index (Mollak), RERA-approved budgets, via Continental Club, 10 Nov 2026
01.alt: Bar chart of median approved service charges in 2026 for six Dubai communities, from AED 12.34 per square foot in Dubai Land to AED 28.67 in Burj Khalifa District, against a citywide median of AED 15.54
